gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads open and unclogged, even in its tiniest counters, which is a relief next to the loud heading. Cherry Swash flares its horseshoe c with diagonals as heavy as its verticals, and over a long passage the body keeps things moving smoothly.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: Sharp, tidy, a little theatrical. Tenor Sans has light but visible stroke variation and c tips that never close up, so a larger size under Cherry Swash's blunt, uniform heading lets those details breathe.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow's bowls open like a cupped palm of clay, giving the sans-serif body a soft, approachable way of reading under the heading. Cherry Swash supplies the swagger.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-trispace: Trispace sets its letters sparse and wide, with curves that open outward rather than curling in, giving the body a spacious look. Cherry Swash sits above it like bent pipe cleaner.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tuffy: Tuffy looks sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, and its widely parted s keeps each line easy to follow. Over a long passage it stays friendly beneath Cherry Swash.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-wix-madefor-displ: Distinctive is the right word for Cherry Swash, whose curves match its stems exactly, with no tapering anywhere in the letters. And Wix Madefor Display follows with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-wix-madefor-text: Professional in manner, Wix Madefor Text uses open terminals that are easy to read, a quiet partner for the blunt Cherry Swash heading. Over a long passage it simply keeps going.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ysabeau-infant: Friendly and sturdy up top. Ysabeau Infant sends its terminals outward like a pair of tongs, which gives the sans-serif body a lively spread beneath Cherry Swash's smooth, pressure-free curves.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Commanding Cherry Swash joins its strokes at full width, with no thin hairline joins anywhere in the letters. And Zalando Sans SemiExpanded answers with open-mouthed curves, so the two sit together with a modern, tidy feel.
gen-gf-comic-relief-clash-grotesk: Bold lettering from Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, with no visible difference between upright and sideways strokes. Clash Grotesk has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, so shrinking the heading would blur the gap between them.
